title: Levobupivacaine During Cholecystectomy
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine the effects of intraperitoneal administration of levobupivacaine on pain after laparoscopic cholecystectomy.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* cholelithiasis
* chronic cholecystitis

Exclusion Criteria:

* hypersensitivity to local anesthetics
* acute cholecystitis
* morbid obesity
